test_name: A plain score engraves at the magnification its config set!s: 5/2 (session 35)
description: The engine's score defaults on, no \magnifyStaff in the score, cnb:default-magnify set! to 5/2 after the include. Measured on 2.24 and 2.26: the staff symbol is 10.0 tall (the engine's default staff, four staff spaces at magnification 5/2) and the default notehead 2.5 x 2.5. The same file at 7/4 gives a staff 7.0 tall and a notehead 1.75 x 1.75, and before session 35 this file gave those too, because the score defaults read the variable when the engine was included.

assertions.description: The staff is 10.0 tall: 5/2 of the 4-space staff, 10/7 of 7/4's 7.0
The first notehead is drawn at magnification 5/2: 2.5 tall (1.75 at 7/4)
